protocol: Mandatory green/red candle price action on M5/M15/H1; closed H1/H4/D1 EMA trend context plus at most one confirmation indicator; ATR stop/trailing; market, stop and limit entries; profitable market-day percentage then activity then trade win rate then daily and total profit objective; train+validation selection; untouched holdout; bid/ask execution.

constraints.profitableDayDefinition: Strictly positive realized P&L on an available non-weekend market day
